summary: Silver Point Private Credit Fund, a Maryland non-listed closed-end fund, filed an 8-K disclosing the termination of its Master Servicing Agreement with U.S. Bancorp Fund Services, LLC, effective December 31, 2026, and entry into a new Sub-Administrative Services Agreement with HS Financial Technologies Corporation effective January 1, 2027. The new agreement runs an initial one-year term with automatic annual renewals, calls for a monthly service fee, and is terminable by the Fund on 60 days' notice or the sub-administrator on 180 days' notice. This is a routine administrative-vendor change, not a special situation.
